ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface area (~85%) with a low-intensity (black) peripheral border and median region (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white blobs forming the primary lobe surfaces. Dark low-intensity banding follows the entire trailing edge. A vertical dark pixel column is centered at the median notch, extending slightly into both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped indentation with an interior angle of approximately 105 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 1/12th of the total vertical extent of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the continuous linear boundary. Amplitude is most pronounced at the distal tips, transitioning to smoother topography near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory; trailing edge follows a broadly convex curve that tapers to sharp, jagged points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least five circular low-contrast spots on the left lobe and several dark pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark linear streaks oriented diagonally on the lower-mid section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular dark accumulations at the extreme lateral tips consistent with barnacle colonization or localized tissue erosion; distinctive dark spot located roughly 10% from the median notch on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, thick black border along the entire trailing edge that exhibits variable thickness, peaking in width at the mid-lobe sections.
